title: Elf Bar 600 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and expense caused by single-use disposables. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Pink Lemonade Flavour: A bright and refreshing combination of sweet mixed berries and zesty lemonade. The balance of ripe berry sweetness and sharp citrus notes delivers a crisp, slightly fizzy sensation that makes every puff feel uplifting and uplifting. Swapping pods is quick and hassle-free—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a convenient way to enjoy your favourite Elf Bar flavours, these prefilled pods deliver exceptional taste in a practical, replaceable format.
